title: The localized phase of pinning models with correlated Gaussian disorder
summary: We demonstrate that the results established for the localized regime of the pinning model with independent disorder -- notably the $\mathcal{C}^\infty$ regularity of the free energy, the scaling of the largest excursion between pinned sites, and the Central Limit Theorems for both the contact number and its mean -- can be generalized to translation-ergodic environments under the hypothesis that disorder is Gaussian. Our results are obtained assuming only summability of the charges' covariances. The two key ingredients for our proofs are the Birkhoff-sum approach introduced in Giacomin,…
